# John Le Fondré

John Le Fondré is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

John Le Fondré has participated in 6 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence with 78.7% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence with 78.6% of the ballot.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence unopposed.
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence unopposed.
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 52.6% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/john-le-fondre-3/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=24JHYcJcseQ)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pmSN0GKFi0s)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-johnlefondre/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/john-le-fondre/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=trJBgryWICk)

John Le Fondré has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/02/23/former-chief-minister-honoured-and-delighted-to-be-asked-to-stand-for-constable-role/)\]

## Election History

### 2005 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) (2 seats), 23rd November 2005.

**John Le Fondré was elected as Deputy of St Lawrence in 2005**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **John Le Fondré** |  | 1,000 | 78.7% |
| 2 | **[Deidre Mezbourian](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/deidre-mezbourian)** |  | 610 | 48% |
| 3 | [Hugh Gill](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hugh-gill) |  | 435 | 34.2% |
| 4 | [Julian Corbet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/julian-corbet) |  | 335 | 26.4% |

1,271 ballots (inc. 3 spoilt papers)

3,149 registered voters

= 40.4% turnout
